description: 1. The agent reads skill/SKILL.md to understand the exact response format and severity taxonomy. 2. It reads all relevant reference files (general.md, security.md, team-conventions.md, python.md, javascript-typescript.md, nodejs.md, php.md) to build the rule set. 3. It reads finpay-app/pr_diff.txt and identifies all three files (.py, .js, .php) applying the correct per-language + universal rules. 4. It generates pr_review_report.md with the EXACT format: starting with '## 📋 Resumen de Revisión del PR', a '**Veredicto:**' line using one of the three emoji+text combinations, a '**Hallazgos:**' line with four severity emoji counts, '**Archivos revisados:** 3', per-file sections using '### 📁 filename' headers, individual findings with '❌ Código actual:' / '✅ Corrección sugerida:' / '**¿Por qué?**' blocks, and ending with '### 🏁 Resumen Final' containing the three sub-bullets. 5. The proprietary trap: the agent MUST use the exact Spanish-language structural markers (📁, 🏁, ❌ Código actual:, ✅ Corrección sugerida:, ¿Por qué?, Hallazgos, Veredicto, etc.) — a generic English code reviewer will fail the format checks. The verdict must be ❌ RECHAZAR or ⚠️ APROBAR CON CAMBIOS due to the BLOCKER-level hardcoded secrets and SQL injections. Minimum 3 🔴 BLOCKER findings must be raised.
